title: Yemen province launches 'peaceful' bid to retake bases after UAE-backed separatist advance
summary: The Saudi-backed governor of Yemen's Hadramawt said on Friday that the province was launching what he described as a "peaceful operation" to retake military positions seized by the UAE-backed Southern Transitional Council last month.
contentText: The Saudi-backed governor of Yemen's Hadramawt said on Friday that the province was launching what he described as a "peaceful operation" to retake military positions seized by the UAE-backed Southern Transitional Council (STC) last month. The declaration came as a series of Saudi air strikes struck an STC military camp in Hadramawt, an official from the separatist group said.
